verdict.rationale: The Split API automatically segments concatenated PDFs into logical document sections based on content categories, and a documented example splits a multi-document PDF using AI-powered classification. Classify and Extract are separate products on the same key and SDK, documented as chainable (Split, then Extract) to get per-document results. Missing for 10: detail on per-segment output format (page ranges, per-document result objects), a single-call packet workflow rather than chained separate APIs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
